title: CB750 Hornet
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Honda CB750 Hornet is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 750cc powertrain delivering 85 HP and 70 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 195 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 15.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
